finding.mechanism: Prompt-level Forge-ready fixes were already merged, but the prior typed-ingress donor PR1512 remained unmerged. Raw worker JSON therefore lacked a canonical deterministic pre-Forge classification primitive capable of separating malformed, schema-invalid, valid-not-ready and syntactically Forge-ready candidates before Evidence Forge clone/evaluation work.
finding.delta: Merged a bounded typed candidate ingress that preserves model output as noncanonical, validates safe paths and commands, validates unified-diff file headers and hunk counts, requires patch-header paths to match declared target_files, emits explicit admission states, and can bind producer repo_head_at_prompt plus worker_sha256. Evidence Forge retains exact-source git-apply/test/negative/static/benchmark authority.
finding.counterhypothesis: The zero-acceptance funnel may primarily be caused by candidate semantics or tests rather than malformed ingress. This delta therefore does not claim causal resolution until post-merge VALID_READY-to-Forge acceptance distribution improves.

go_tracks.A_ENTITYOS_EXECUTABLE_CONVERGENCE: ADVANCED: PR1561 merged; malformed/non-ready architecture deltas can now be rejected deterministically before Forge evaluation.
go_tracks.B_HCU_TYPED_ENTRY: ADVANCED: reusable typed candidate admission surface with explicit status/provenance and fail-closed patch grammar.
go_tracks.C_GLOBAL_JSPACE_GWT_TRAINING_READINESS: ADVANCED_BOUNDED: HCU/J-Space worker deltas can reuse the same deterministic candidate/provenance representation for later trace/dataset admission; no model-specific causal or training credit granted.
